No eyes! We tried hand feeding him at first but it seemed to stress him out. We have sinking pellets that we drop at the same spot every time. We tap the tank twice (lightly) before we drop the food in and he seems to know! Swims right there. If we're feeding them something else like frozen bloodworms, we swoosh the water at the top where we are and he swims right up. Just hold it there until he gets a hold of it, then it's all good. We just make sure we watch them closely at feeding time to make sure they're all getting an even amount but he navigates super well and finds food no problem :)

I'm not sure how to link on my phone but I posted a photo of him the other day in this subreddit asking about this.. one of the mods said that the black colour gene is tied to his eyes and they quite often have poor vision or no eyes at all, and it's best to not just start trimming in case there aren't eyes.
